capabilities: Register folder roots with short prefixes in settings
Convert pasted Windows file and folder paths into links
Open linked files and folders in the default application
Map the same prefix to different local paths on each device
Write links manually with obsidian://ens URLs
extras: Desktop only and requires Obsidian 1.5.0+; Windows paths only; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; settings from older versions are migrated automatically.
problem: Obsidian links only reach files inside the vault, and a synced folder like Dropbox has a different local path on each device, so direct paths break across machines.

relations.evidence: shared work in services like Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, or a network drive

summary: Prefix-based linker that turns pasted Windows paths into clickable links to files and folders outside the vault, with per-device path mapping.
